niche_preference_profile: This user prefers clean, modern, app-like interfaces that feel spacious but still information-rich. They like clear hierarchy, concise copy, obvious actions, and well-structured sections/cards. They generally prefer light or softly colored surfaces over heavy dark themes, but they also like dark modal overlays when the modal itself is the focus. They dislike clutter, marketing-style hero imagery, ambiguous labels, and layouts that feel sparse, unfinished, or overly empty.

criteria.description: Stronger title/section hierarchy with a single clear focal point and less competing content.
Airy, well-spaced screens that avoid crowding, but do not waste space with excessive emptiness.
Short, direct, task-focused copy that explains what is happening without being verbose or promotional.
Cleanly separated sections and cards with logical grouping and easy scanability.
Prominent, easy-to-find CTAs and row actions that make the next step immediately clear.
Screens that show enough content to feel complete and useful, without becoming cluttered.
A contemporary, finished, app-store-polished look rather than a utilitarian, dated, or placeholder feel.
Clean rounded cards or simple surfaces with subtle dividers, avoiding heavy borders or overly complex paneling.
Explicit, standard, easy-to-understand labels for settings, statuses, and controls.
Interfaces that feel immediately configurable and action-oriented, not like a slideshow or marketing intro.
